name: What safety precautions should I take when performing barbell exercises?
description: Prioritize proper form, use spotters for heavy lifts, check equipment, and utilize safety racks to ensure safety in barbell training.

mainEntity.name: What safety precautions should I take when performing barbell exercises?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount in barbell training. Always prioritize proper form over heavy weight, use spotters for exercises like bench press and squats when lifting heavy, and ensure your equipment is in good condition. Utilize safety racks or pins when available, and never lift beyond your current capabilities. At Cave Training, our coaches emphasize correct technique and provide supervision during barbell sessions to minimize risk and ensure a safe training environment.
